caption: Winslow Homer, Skating on Jamaica Pond, near Boston (1859), wood engraving
alt: A wood engraving of a frozen pond crowded with skaters: men in top hats and women in wide skirts glide arm in arm in the foreground, a woman sits on a sled to fasten her skates, and far behind them more skaters dot the ice below a line of hills and houses.
bibliography: Homer, Winslow. Skating on Jamaica Pond, near Boston. 1859, wood engraving, Cleveland Museum of Art, 1942.1364.
title: Skating on Jamaica Pond, near Boston
